instruction:
You are a helpful assistant that creates behavior trees for multi-robot teams.
Your task:
- Convert the provided natural-language mission description into an XML-formatted multi-agent behavior tree.
- The behavior tree must be compatible with the BehaviorTree.CPP library (<root BTCPP_format="4">), with one <BehaviorTree> per robot coordinated by a main tree.
- Use Fallback nodes to recover from the failures mentioned in the mission.
- Use SignalReady/WaitReady and the Handover/Co* joint nodes for inter-robot coordination.

Output Requirements:
- Output only the XML representation of the behavior tree. Do not include explanations, comments, or any additional text.
- Every robot mentioned in the mission must have its own <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_<name>">.
input:
Today’s mission sends two robots through the inpatient wing. Alpha (id alpha) begins in the pharmacy (pharmacy), where the clean linens pack (linens_pack) is waiting. Beta (id beta) starts in the laboratory (lab), the delivery target. Alpha’s route is limited to the pharmacy and the west ward (ward_west); Beta’s route is limited to the west ward and the laboratory. That makes the west ward the only handoff point.

The building is compact but requires care. The charging nook (charge_nook), the wing’s only charging station, connects to the pharmacy, the east ward (ward_east), and the west ward. The pharmacy also opens directly into the west ward, and the west ward connects to the laboratory. On the other side, the laboratory connects to the nurses’ station (nurses_station), and the nurses’ station connects back to the laboratory. The east ward is a dead end except for the charging nook.

The plan: Alpha carries the linens pack out of the pharmacy into the west ward, then transfers it to Beta. The first handover attempt may fumble, so be prepared to retry until Beta has a firm grip. Beta then carries the pack into the laboratory, completing the mission.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="pharmacy"/>
                <IsItemAt item="linens_pack" location="pharmacy"/>
                <PickUp robot="alpha" item="linens_pack" location="pharmacy"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="pharmacy" to="ward_west"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="ward_west"/>
                <SignalReady robot="alpha" item="linens_pack" to="beta"/>
                <Fallback>
                    <HandoverGive giver="alpha" receiver="beta" item="linens_pack" location="ward_west"/>
                    <HandoverGive giver="alpha" receiver="beta" item="linens_pack" location="ward_west"/>
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="lab" to="ward_west"/>
            <Sequence>
                <WaitReady robot="beta" item="linens_pack" from="alpha"/>
                <Fallback>
                    <HandoverTake receiver="beta" giver="alpha" item="linens_pack" location="ward_west"/>
                    <HandoverTake receiver="beta" giver="alpha" item="linens_pack" location="ward_west"/>
                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="ward_west" to="lab"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="beta" item="linens_pack"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="beta" item="linens_pack" location="lab"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

Attention Alpha (id alpha) and Beta (id beta), begin logistics operation. The warehouse is configured as a network of hubs. The charging bay (charge_bay) opens onto shelf A (shelf_a) and shelf C (shelf_c). From shelf C, routes lead to the packing station (packing_station), shelf A, shelf B (shelf_b), and the charging bay. Shelf B also connects to the loading dock (loading_dock), which is the mission destination for both items. The packing station connects to the loading dock and shelf C, making it a natural starting point.

Alpha, you start at shelf B. Retrieve the small box (box_small) from shelf C and deliver it to the loading dock. Beta, you are already at the packing station. Take the red crate (crate_red) from the packing station and bring it to the loading dock as well. Be aware: the loading dock connects to the packing station and shelf B; shelf A connects only to the charging bay and shelf C. Shelf C is a central junction, and the charging bay is the only charging station, so route planning should account for energy needs. Both items must end up at the loading dock. Coordinate your paths through the shared junctions, avoid congestion at shelf C, and complete the transfer.

    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="shelf_b" to="shelf_c"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="shelf_c"/>
                <IsItemAt item="box_small" location="shelf_c"/>
                <PickUp robot="alpha" item="box_small" location="shelf_c"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="shelf_c" to="shelf_b"/>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="shelf_b" to="loading_dock"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="alpha" item="box_small"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="alpha" item="box_small" location="loading_dock"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="packing_station"/>
                <IsItemAt item="crate_red" location="packing_station"/>
                <PickUp robot="beta" item="crate_red" location="packing_station"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="packing_station" to="loading_dock"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="beta" item="crate_red"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="beta" item="crate_red" location="loading_dock"/>

input: The tremor had turned the site into a maze of fractured concrete and twisted metal. Alpha (id alpha), waiting at the charging post (charge_post), and Beta (id beta), stationed at the medical tent (medical_tent), received their orders. The heavy debris slab (debris_slab_heavy) lay in the north zone (zone_north), and it had to be brought to the rubble pile (rubble_pile). Before Alpha could move from the charging post toward base camp (base_camp), it had to inspect the corridor between them; if debris blocked the passage, Alpha could use ClearPath to clear it. From base camp, routes led to the rubble pile, the north zone, and the charging post. The charging post also connected to the south zone (zone_south), while the medical tent connected to the rubble pile and the north zone. The rubble pile linked to base camp and the medical tent; the north zone linked to base camp, the medical tent, and the south zone; and the south zone linked back to the charging post and the north zone. The team would have to coordinate—Alpha clearing the route, Beta scouting ahead—so the slab could be hauled from the north zone through adjoining areas to the rubble pile.

<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="charge_post" to="base_camp"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <ClearPath robot="alpha" edge_from="charge_post" edge_to="base_camp"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="charge_post" to="base_camp"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="base_camp" to="zone_north"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="zone_north"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="debris_slab_heavy" location="zone_north"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="debris_slab_heavy" from="zone_north" to="base_camp"/>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="debris_slab_heavy" from="base_camp" to="rubble_pile"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="rubble_pile"/>
                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="debris_slab_heavy" location="rubble_pile"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="medical_tent" to="zone_north"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="zone_north"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="debris_slab_heavy" location="zone_north"/>
